parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory tree — a canonical sample-app path per the restraint rules. Even though the is_sample_app flag is reported false, the file path itself is the authoritative restraint marker. Lifting the shared 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.next' implementation into a common location would couple production DebugPanel code to sample-app demonstration semantics. The duplication is therefore intentional: the sample app carries its own local copy of the display-link async iterator to remain self-contained.
